instruction: Candid action photograph, medium-full shot. In an indoor martial arts studio, the bearded Black man in a white gi (R1) on the left and the Asian man with braided hair in a gray gi (R2) on the right are locked in a close grapple on a dark mat. Both lean forward with their heads pressed together near the shoulder in a collar-and-elbow tie-up. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
